subject: Discovery recap and scheduling: private hosting architecture deep dive
messages:
From: Alex Greene <alex.greene@clearpathhealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jandell Park <jandell.park@clearpathhealth.com>
Date: 2026-06-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick follow-up — private hosting deep dive

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the call this morning — the discovery was helpful. We want to move to a technical deep dive focused on our Private/VPC on-prem requirements before we get too far on procurement. High-level constraints to note up front:

- Air-gapped option may be required for certain sites (contractual).
- KMS/HSM integration for keys; must support our Azure Key Vault and on-prem HSM options.
- Network egress will be tightly controlled; we’ll need exact IP ranges and ports.

Can you put together a 60–75 minute architecture review with your ops/architect team (we’ll include our infra leads)? Our preferred windows next week are: Tue 6/15 between 10–13 PT or Thu 6/17 morning PT. If those don’t work, propose alternatives.

I’ve attached a short security summary and added Jandell (infra lead) to the thread. Looking for a concrete list of prep items from your side so we can loop in our SREs.

Thanks,
Alex

--
Alex Greene
Director, Cloud Engineering | ClearPath Health
alex.greene@clearpathhealth.com
(415) 555-0191

Attachment: ClearPath-Security-Summary.pdf (PDF, 420 KB)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Greene <alex.greene@clearpathhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jandell Park <jandell.park@clearpathhealth.com>
Date: 2026-06-08T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up — private hosting deep dive

Hi Alex — great to connect earlier. Appreciate the clear constraints.

We can definitely run a 60–75 minute architecture review that covers: deployment modes (VPC vs on-prem), network and firewall requirements (IP/port matrix), key management options (Azure KV, HSM integrations), data residency & retention, and an ops playbook for failover/fallback.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue 6/15 10:30–11:45
- Tue 6/15 12:00–13:15
- Thu 6/17 09:00–10:15

Please pick one and we’ll send a calendar invite.

Prep from our side (attached checklist):
- Network checklist (IP ranges, outbound ports, proxy requirements) — see attached "ClearPath-Network-Checklist.pdf".
- Short runbook we’ll share ahead of the call: mapping of model variants to resource profiles.
- Ops attendees: Karthik (lead architect) + Marissa (solutions engineer) will join to walk through deployment and perf tradeoffs.

Questions for you before the call:
1) Which sites require air-gapped installs?
2) Expected peak concurrent inference QPS per site (ballpark is fine).
3) Any compliance docs we should read in advance besides the security summary you attached?

If you confirm a slot, we’ll circulate a brief agenda + prep doc to your SREs.

Best,
Priyom
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai

Attachment: ClearPath-Network-Checklist.pdf (PDF, 48 KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Greene <alex.greene@clearpathhealth.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-09T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up — private hosting deep dive

Adding a quick note from the architect perspective — happy to focus on the network/egress patterns and our KV cache behavior during the session. If Jandell can share a basic topology diagram (even a hand sketch) ahead of time it will let me prepare targeted questions.

Also: if air-gapped is in scope, please flag which package (full on-prem bundle vs. edge-only) you want us to cover.

-Karthik
Staff Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

(On Tue, Jun 8, 2026 at 11:03 AM Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai> wrote:)

From: Jandell Park <jandell.park@clearpathhealth.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-09T13:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up — private hosting deep dive

Thanks — we’ll take Tue 6/15 10:30–11:45 PT.

Quick answers:
- Air-gapped required for two pilot sites (SF and Rochester). Others can be VPC.
- Ballpark concurrent QPS: 8–12 across users during peak (planning for up to 20 during heavy test windows).
- I attached a topology sketch and our compliance snapshot. We’re short-staffed but I’ll loop in our SRE lead on the calendar invite.

Jandell
Sr. Infrastructure Engineer | ClearPath Health
ops@clearpathhealth.com

Attachment: clearpath_topology_sketch.png (PNG, 85 KB); ClearPath-Security-Summary.pdf (previously attached)

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Greene <alex.greene@clearpathhealth.com>, Jandell Park <jandell.park@clearpathhealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-10T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up — private hosting deep dive

Confirmed for Tue 6/15 10:30–11:45 PT — calendar invite sent (placeholder). Agenda & prep items below:

Agenda (60–75m):
- 5m quick intros & goals
- 20m architecture overview: deployment modes & packaging (Marissa)
- 20m network, IPs, and egress policy (Karthik)
- 15m KMS/HSM and data flow (Priyom + Karthik)
- 10–20m open Q&A and next steps (rollout timeline & POC ask)

Prep for your team (if possible):
- Confirm list of air-gapped sites (names & contact) — Jandell provided two, please add any others.
- Share basic topology (thanks for the sketch) and any firewall/proxy policies we should be aware of.
- If possible, bring a sample SLA/acceptance criteria for the POC.

Action items we’ll own before the call:
- Share a 2-page runbook covering ports/IPs, required OS/packages, and model storage layouts.
- Provide a short checklist for KMS integration options (Azure KV vs. HSM).
- Attach the internal runbook link in the invite (sent).

Looking forward — we’ll keep this practical and ops-focused.

Best,
Priyom
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai
